Nocticadia #1

Nocticadia

Keri Lake

4.18
227,349 ratings32,339 reviews
Rate this book
After watching my mother succumb to a mysterious illness, I promised myself two things: I’d find the cure for what ravaged her—and leave the godforsaken city where she abandoned me.

Four years later, I receive an acceptance letter from Dracadia University, a secluded, prestigious school on an island off the coast of Maine. Legends say it’s haunted by the exiled souls of long-dead patients.

But the ghosts aren’t even its most daunting peculiarity.

Devryck Bramwell, known on campus as Doctor Death, is my devastatingly handsome professor. He loathes first-years like me—yet his dark gaze tells me all the ways he’d devour me if given the chance, and his stolen kisses burn with forbidden jealousy. Together, we’re a toxic disaster waiting to be exposed.

And when the truth surfaces, we may be the ones to resurrect Dracadia’s most depraved secret.

♾️ ⭐️s Hands down my favorite read of 2024 so far. OH. MY. GOD. I need this book INJECTED INTO MY VEINS!!! Keri Lake, where have you been all my life?!!! This book was sheer perfection, I wouldn’t change a single goddamn thing!

The gothic world, the academic setting, the tension, the spice, the banter, the writing, the characters, the romance, the plot….. ABSOLUTE MASTERPIECE

This book is DARK and TWISTED and really made me question my morals, and I ate up every last word on the page like a starved feral animal.

I seriously have never read ANYTHING like this before. The atmosphere was so spooky and haunting, and the world is so immersive I felt like I was watching everything take place through the characters eyes! The plot was absolutely INSANITY! I seriously could not predict the plot twists at the end and the last 20% had me pacing back and forth with anxiety, I LOVED IT! The science nerd in me also went crazy for this, even if they are studying a completely fictional disease, Keri Lakes attention to detail made it feel so realistic! The perfect balance of plot and romance that had me quite literally incapable of putting this book down.

Professor Devryk Bramwell aka Doctor Death… DONT EVEN GET ME STARTED ON THE FUCKING MAN! I don’t even know how to properly articulate how much I love this grumpy, traumatized, dark, sarcastic, smart, dimpled man. His inner monologue was everything to me, I never wanted to leave his head. He’s so unserious and sarcastic and unintentionally hilarious, I was giddy every time he opened his damn mouth. He has such a hard exterior and lets his guard down for no one because this man has been to hell and fucking back. His past made my heart hurt but I absolutely loved the way Keri Lake told the story of his childhood and upbringing, GENIUS. The words this man uttered were a cross between absolute poetry and down right filthy. How possessive and obsessed he gets with Lilia had me SWEATING. He literally had me giggling and kicking my feet the whole time, one of my new favorite book men of all time. I will never get this man out of my head. For example….

“The wealthy possess an insatiable appetite for the rare and priceless. They stare because you’re the only thing worth staring at.”

“You’re a sickness inside of me that begs never to be cured. Infecting me with this unshakable craving for things I shouldn’t want.”

“She was the warmth of the sun on a cold and rotting corpse. The first breath after a lifetime of death.”

“Her name was a dirty scalpel plunged deep inside my chest, past crumbling bones and decayed flesh. It pierced the only organ I vowed could never be touched again and infected me with insufferable greed.”

“I don’t think I’ll be able to stay away from you after this. But let me be very clear, I don’t share. If anyone else so much as looks at this pu$$y, I’ll take pleasure in dissecting him, starting with his eyeballs.”

“I have lived a lifetime in death–a cold existence in an endless void. It wasn’t until you came along and cast the first ray of light that I felt a pulse of life. A pull that I couldn’t resist. It was you who dragged my heart from this insensate slumber. And it’s you for whom it beats now. It’s a fucking wreckage, though. Scarred and caged by ravaged bones. But it belongs only to you.”

Lilia, I couldn’t love this girl more if I tried! Her character development and growth brought tears to my eyes. She is a fucking FIGHTER! It’s rare to find an FMC that is damaged and vulnerable, but also has the strongest backbone and doesn’t let anyone else fight her battles, especially not a man. I adored how she fought for what she truly deserved and never backed down despite the odds being against her on multiple occasions. I loved how she found solace in Devryn but also never backed down from the challenges he presented. This girl must be protected at all fucking costs.

Lilia and Devryn honestly, one of my favorite fictional couples of all time. There’s just something about a professor student relationship that DOES SOMETHING TO ME like nothing else! The tension, the constant push and pull, will they won’t they???!! Gets me REELING! The definition of soulmates. One truly does not exist without the other.
- the heated glances from afar
- The longing
- The angst
- The banter
- The hair tucks
- The stolen touches
- The most scrumptious slow burn
- THE FUCKING SPICE!!!! Don’t even get me started, some of the best spicy scenes I have ever read im actually getting hot just thinking about it.

For my Zodiac academy lovers, they are so BlueLance coded it’s not even funny.

I could rave about this book for HOURS ON END!! I now have a gaping hole in my heart that will never be filled. Please read this. I’m not the same person I was before I new this masterpieces existed.

Damn I don't read a lot of gothic romance but this one sure peaked my interest. I went in with the expectations that the main characters in this have to live up to Blue Lance from Zodiac Academy and boy, they absolutely did.

The first 40-45% of the book was really slow in my opinion so I was a tad unsure then but after that the way it picked up 🤌 I did not want to put the book down at all.

The plot was super intriguing. NGL the prologue had me confused initially but things started making sense soon enough. Can tell how much thought and work the author put into this book, absolutely worth reading. So kudos to her 🙌 Although it's romance but the sub plot was so gothically pleasing to read. Of course it's unrealistic (I sure hope so) but the way it was pulled off 🤌

Lilia and Devryck are EVERYTHING 😩🥵 They are so perfect for each other. I liked how both of them had perfect balance in the story and one didn't overpower the other. The chemistry and heat is off the charts. And thank goodness Lilia is not dumb.

Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck Devryck 🥵😩❤️ Say hello to my new book boyfriend. Man's so hot and dreamy I'm not even exaggerating. He was making me swoon so much it's embarrassing. I loved his jealous, possessive ass.

The angst and slow burn was delicious. The spice was oof 🥵🥵🤭🤭 *fans self* Read to find out 👀 One thing I really appreciated was that Lilia did not kept things (majority of the times) from Devryck which didn't cause any unnecessary conflicts or drama. I liked she was open about the problems she was being put through as it gave them time to resolve those things and the fact that Devryck reassured her EVERY. DAMN. TIME. 🤌🤌🤌🤌

Need me a man like him.

The ending was satisfying and am so glad I read this. Possibly one of the best books I've read this year so far but let's see if that changes. I rate it 4.5 stars instead of 5 cause of the initial pacing. If you push through it, am pretty sure you'll end up loving the book.

Recommended.

Note- There are a lot of gore and vivid descriptions, some real creepy and strange. There's also violence, and abusive situations towards the FMC (not caused by the MMC).

~•~•~

Cause apparently it gives Blue Lance vibes 😌

♾️ STUNNED. Might be one of my fave books of all time. I would poison myself with Noctisoma for Professor Bramwell or to reread this book all over again. Zero questions, seriously just give me all the noxberries I’ll eat them from a bowl idgaf. This needs to be the STANDARD for a contemporary dark gothic romance. Equal parts plot and romance, but heavy on both. It’s daaaark, haunting, beautiful, horrific, romantic, spicyyyyy, thrilling, symbolic, and all-consuming.

"It was my mother, my refusal to accept her death, to accept what the world had taken from me, that had brought me to Dracadia in the first place. And it was there that I'd faced death head-on. So smitten, I fell in love with him--his abrasive heart and blood-stained hands." 🧪💜☠️🪱🐦‍⬛🖤✨🥵

LITTLE MOTH. Picture this: Dracadia, an elite ivy league-type university situated on a small island off the coast of New England. Collegiate vibes on a gothic campus straight out of cambridge and a haunted history rife with secrets, death, and Native American tribal lore. A mysterious disease called Noctisoma that exists only on the island. Secret academic societies where members wear plague masks. A smoldering sexy young professor nicknamed DOCTOR DEATH with black hair and copper eyes. Said professor is also brooding (bc duh) and ignores everyone but you (touch-her-and-you-die vibes…..literally). Midnight labs where Doctor Death lectures about this creepy as hell disease through tanks filled with swimming black worms and purple moths that turn black when infected. Apparent suicides in women that, on second glance, all appear to have links to black worms......including the FMC’s mother.

So. LITTLE MOTH aka Lilia who is incredible writes a paper at her community college in Massachusetts about a "fictional" disease, only she bases it on what she actually witnessed during her own mother's death. After submitting it, her professor recognizes the disease as the one that Dracadia studies and recommends her to Dracadia's dean. She's then whisked off to Dracadia, which is also her dream school, where she meets Professor Bramwell, aka Doctor Death, aka the professor who specializes in this disease, aka the dreamiest devilish alpha 30ish year old mad scientist smokeshow. NOW picture this: a slooooowwww burn romance with Doctor Death. Secret trysts that grow spicier and spicier and spicier until the entire jar of spice is simply dumped all over you. Again, I would risk Noctisoma if it meant having Prof Bramwell. The romance is not insta-lust or insta-love but authentic and real. Lilia and Bramwell are each other's moths and flames. They are each other's toxins and antivenoms, one's life to the other's death. But its not just that one of them embodies one trait--at times, Lilia is Bramwell's toxin and medicine, and at times Bramwell is Lilia's life and her death. They contemplate each other in a deadly way. 🧪💀💜

Perfect writing (like so good even your english prof would agree). Perfect dark gothic romance. Perfect professor-student romance. Perfect academic setting. Perfect creepy af disease plot. Perfect spice that makes you want to go back to college and do it a bit…..differently. Perfect suspense and WTF is going on?! vibes. The last 20% is such thrilling high stakes chaos that I had to catch my breath. I'm reeling from how much I'm obsessed with Lilia's and Bramwell's story. AND its dual first person POV between them, and being in Bramwell's mind when he starts falling for Lilia is...something else.

I will never recover from this until Keri Lake agrees to write a sequel. Even if its just the day to day boring lives of Lilia and Bramwell. I will read about them doing f*cking laundry and washing dishes together if it means I get more. One million stars.

┆ ⤿ 🦇 ⌗ thoughts
⟡ to preference, i am not a dark romance girlie by any means. every time i try to get into the genre, it always ends up being too dark for me (i know, how paradoxical). however, i really enjoyed this one.

⟡ this book follows lilia vespertine, who leaves her hometown to attend dracadia university to investigate the stange, mysterious death of her mother. this university specializes in studying the parasite "noctisoma", which lilia believes may be the reason for her mother's passing. while she's there, she begins to learn secrets while engaging in a forbidden romance with her professor, whose leading the noctisoma studies.

⤿ ⌞ side note. while it's forbidden + an age gap trope, this takes place in a college setting and the fmc is 20 years old⌝


⟡ to begin, i really liked the writing of this book. when i read books, i love for there to be beautiful descriptions and alluring writing, and this book delivered just that. the way keri lake perfectly transmitted me into this world was so amazing, and i struggled to put this book down at night or to do my daily tasks because it was so good. i would love to read this book during the fall time, because the dark academia vibes really would be perfect for a foggy autumn day.

⟡ i also really liked how this was more than a romance. there were spooky, thrilling aspects to it, as well as mysteries being unsolved and other things. getting to learn more about this disease with lilia was so fun, it really felt like i was in her shoes as she was discovering more about it. same with her family history, and getting to learn about the weird things involving her mother and the university was interesting as well. there were times where i felt horrified as well, HINT : THE WORMS 😭 overall, it was just a good expierence and i'm surprised more people aren't talking about it on goodreads (at least from my mutuals)

⊹ ࣪ ˖ “calling her beautiful was like calling the sun lukewarm. she’d blazed like the hottest part of a flame in that dress. and fuck me, i’d felt the heat.”


┆ ⤿ 🕷 ⌗ characters

⌗ ┆ lilia verspertine

despite what i've seen in some reviews about her, i genuinely enjoyed her character. she was such a badass, and she was actually not as aggrivating as i thought she would be. a pattern i've noticed with dark romances is that the fmcs are portrayed often as a 'helpless, damsel in distress who needs saving from her murderer boyfriend', which is always just so boring and dull 🙄 luckily, lila wasn't that way at all, at least most of the time. she was empowering and dynamic, and seeing her drive to learn more about her mother's death was inspiring to read about. we love a motivated queen. also the scene where she's filming herself in the classroom.... i don't need to say anymore 🤭

⌗ ┆ devryck bramwell

a mannnn 🫦🫦 i actually loved him so much, he's not my usual kind of book boyfriend but i'll take him. him being her professor and being older than her just screams lana del rey, and he was so ultraviolence coded (specifically shades of cool). while i do like the golden boys better, he definitely was giving with the "touch her and i'll kill you" vibes and i genuinely loved it so much. the scenes where he's teaching but won't stop looking at her live rent free in my mind. i loved men who have a soft spot for their girls <3

the scene where he calls his lawyer to immediately have her video on that strange website taken down after she posts it, saying she can find money a different way because he didn't want other men watching her 🫣 if you know, you know

⌗ ┆ devryck + lilia

teacher x student is one of my least favorite tropes ever, i think i'm still traumatized from lolita/my dark vanessa LOL. but it was, of course, done right this time. forbidden romances are always amazing, and them sneaking around this school because it's prohibited was so fun (but also thrilling) to read about. all the little stolen glances and kisses throughout the classes and in-between them>>> and they were such a power couple once they got together, i was rooting for them so hard

⊹ ࣪ ˖ “you don’t have to be scared. i will never hurt you, lilia. in fact, i’ll rain hell on anyone who ever hurts you again.”


┆ ⤿ 🗝️ ⌗ final thoughts
⟡ i really liked this book and i would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a spooky, dark academic gothic romance (that's so much more than a romance 🤭).

⟡ my one problem with this book, though, was the last 80% were very rushed but somehow dragged at the same time? there was just too much going on, and i think we could've left without the secret society stuff/the stuff with bramwell's brother. otherwise, i think this book would've been a 4.5 stars! i will definitely be reading more titles from this author in the future <3

Age rec: 18+; also, check the trigger warnings as there are graphic medical elements included with mentions of death, rot, worms, etc.

Words are too short to explain how I was completely blown away by this. A 700-page book felt like a daunting task, so I switched to the audiobook format and what a ride that turned out to be! Aaron Shedlock’s narration brought an entirely new LEVEL of intensity to the table. His voice alone is almost dangerous and salivating-worthy🤤. Even though the story had some WILDLY scandalous moments, the sheer magnetism of the audio experience of mine made it impossible to put it down. I'm taking off just half a star, but consider me thoroughly converted🫡.

Nocticadia absofudginglutely nails the dark academia's aesthetic with all the institutional secrets and the aspect of an obsession with knowledge. Dracadia University is a character in its own. Surrounded by cold waters and rumoured ghost stories, the campus is steeped in dread. Unlike stories where academia is just a decorative backdrop, the curriculum and research here matter and I truly loved how researched this was. Lilia’s (the fmc) academic pursuits focus heavily on pathology, parasites(noctisoma) and science which made me immensely fascinated with the matter being a non-bio student.

what to expect:
𖤐 professor x student [even though, I hate this trope, this one's a masterpiece]
𖤐 age-gap
𖤐 secret society
𖤐 lots of info on parasitology
𖤐 slow burn
𖤐 morally grey mmc

The romance was just... a chef's kiss. Lilia and Devryck were so hawt. I fell for Devryck as soon as he was introduced as a brilliant, cynical pathologist known chillingly on campus as "Doctor Death." I mean- who wouldn't? I always fall for mmcs like him who are such a misanthrope and their only reason for existence is their one woman. Ahh! The slow-burn was pure torture in the best way possible. Their interactions were heavy with unspoken hunger and electric stolen glances in dark labs. I also loved the fact that Lilia held her ground as a fiercely resilient woman, preventing the power imbalance from feeling one-sided.

I don't usually recommend books like this but then I do not wish to gate keep this one. I freaking loved this one so I'd highly recommend this one but only if you do read DRs occasionally. Lastly, I wish to reread this someday, very soon enough!

omg this book was SO. FREAKING. GOOD. I LOVE DARK ACADEMIA AND GOTHIC ROMANCE (this is definitely my alter ego speaking), AND THIS BOOK DELIVERED. i’ve never read anything quite like it, and i kid you not, i was completely hooked from the very first chapter.

that said, i didn’t rate it 5 stars for a few reasons:
1. chapter 25-28 made me kinda uncomfortable and gave me second-hand embarrassment 🤦🏻‍♀️😭
2. the author seemed to lose focus on the plot at one point because lilia and devryck could not stop smashing each other.
3. the last 20% of the book felt underwhelming. while the author masterfully established a slow, suspenseful, and deeply eerie atmosphere along with an intriguing plot, the conclusion felt rushed due to the rapid-fire revelations, leaving me unsatisfied. on top of that, the last chapter and epilogue felt so unnecessary, and i was left with so many unanswered questions.

ᡣ𐭩.ᐟ lilia
lilia is strong and independent, i’ll give her that, but she’s certainly not the wisest 😭

ᡣ𐭩.ᐟ devryck
devryck is hot and all, but i didn’t really swoon over him 👀 i’m sorry but he’s nothing like orion, and no other professor can compare to my man lance. i loved how he shared his backstory as if it were story time though.

ᡣ𐭩.ᐟ lilia and devryck
the tension and slow burn were executed really well, but i honestly couldn’t feel their connection beyond their constant lust for each other. i picked this book up hoping for a good ‘professor x student’ romance, but the plot was so captivating that i ended up not caring much about the romance 🫢

This was the first book I ever added to my TBR when I joined Goodreads… and look at me now. Two years later, I finally read it and I have one thing to say:

I didn’t just eat this book. I devoured it, swallowed it, digested it, wrote the recipe, opened a restaurant, and became the chef. 👩‍🍳✨

And the recipe is: professor/student trope.

Actually, scratch that. Not a trope. A lifestyle. A religion. A personality trait I apparently didn’t know I needed. 😂

I was already halfway converted thanks to Lance Orion, but Professor Bramwell came in, looked me in the eyes, and said: “You’re joining the cult now.” And honestly? I had no choice.

I’m not even going to explain the plot because I’m probably the last person on Earth — actually, possibly the last person in the entire solar system — who finally picked this up. Everyone else has already written dissertations about it. 😂

The spice? 🔥🔥🔥
The mystery? Chef’s kiss. 🤌
The whole atmosphere? Exactly what I needed.

My only complaint: the ending dragged a little and I think this could have been about 100 pages shorter. But honestly? This book came at the perfect time because I was struggling to find something that would actually grab me again.

Turns out, I didn’t need “a good book.” I needed THIS.

Professor/student trope believers, I see you now. I understand. I have been enlightened. 🙏

➥ lilia vespertine finds herself with a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity: attending Dracadia university to study and uncover the truth behind her mother’s death. dracadia is on a secluded island, it's rumored to be haunted by the souls of the mental patients exiled there centuries before. those whose bones are said to make up the island's white sandy shores. And restless ghosts aren't even its most daunting peculiarity. but then there’s also the handsome professor devryck bramwell, a pathologist with as many skeletons in his closet as lilia.
the dead have much to teach, and it's only a matter of time before Dracadia's most depraved secret is resurrected.

ˏˋ°•*⁀➷ Lilia & Devryck💜🖤
these two made me question my morals ngl. but the romance between them was *chef fucking kiss*!!!
lilia is smart and brilliant, she asks lots of questions (to which devryck pretends to be annoyed by, but he’s actually a proud fucker); she’s passionate and absolutely strong. she knows when to fight and when to flee. she’s curious and cunning. her passion is what drove her to dig into her mother’s death cause. she’s no fool, even tho people have always claimed she was crazy. she knew something wasn’t normal the day her mother passed away, so she wants to uncover the truth and hopefully find a cure to help others.

devryck (aka doctor death) is morally gray, perpetually annoyed by people and a total bastard—but i love him for it. he uses sarcasm and black humor all the time, making him unintentionally funny. he’s a man of his word: make no mistake, if he makes a threat, be sure he’ll follow through. his past and his illness made my heart ache for him.

together, they are the perfect duo. they share the same interest in science and you can definitely see how their love for each other grows all throughout the book. from their first glance to their first kiss, everything felt so natural and inevitable because they clearly couldn’t stay away from each other.
i LOVED the dynamics between the two of them. the tension and banter, the angst, the heated glances, the stolen kisses and slow burn… TRUST ME WHEN I SAY THIS BOOK ATE AND LEFT NO CRUMBS!
aaa i loved them so much!!!

”She was the warmth of the sun on a cold and rotting corpse. The first breath after a lifetime of death.”


overall, i’ve been hooked on this book since page one. the academic setting, the dark themes, the tension, the writing—everything was so fucking good. the intricate plot and the final twist left me with my jaw on the floor. this is the perfect book if you want something spooky, creepy and disturbing but also hot and mysterious.
this is truly one of the best book i’ve read this year. i have no criticism about it bc everything was on fucking point. i’ve never read anything like this and i’m definitely picking up more of keri lake’s books bc i love her writing.
DEFINITELY RECOMMENDED!
ALSO, we have a novella about bee??????? omg????? this is insane! brb i have to read it asap!🏃🏻‍♀️💨

onto the next💋

Without a doubt, Lilia Vespertine was going to be a massive headache.
But she was MY headache.

In a normal human being, it might’ve triggered an urge to get the heck out of there, because what the hell kind of person would’ve been caught on a rocky cliff, in the woods, with a man who carved corpses at night?

“That is the tragedy of women, isn’t it? We deny ourselves beauty for the sake of misleading men.”

Again, the thought of Professor Bramwell studying my puke somehow seemed worse than him handcuffing me to a bed inside what must’ve been a prison at one time. Crazy, but that was my state of mind right then.

Calling her beautiful was like calling the sun lukewarm. She’d blazed like the hottest part of a flame in that dress. And fuck me, I’d felt the heat.

“Says who? I happen to get very attached to my fictional boyfriends.” Yet another frown. “Boyfriends?”
“I read a lot.”

If the man buried his compliments that way, or softened his insults behind handsome smiles and poetic words.

Curiosity and trepidation clashed his eyes, and he skated his palm down my cheek, pausing to rub his fingers together. His thumb caressed my bottom lip, and his hand moved to my hair again, where he let a strand slip through his fingers, eyes alight with fascination. “I feel you.”

Lilia. Her name was a dirty scalpel plunged deep inside my chest, past crumbling bones and decayed flesh. It pierced the only organ I vowed could never be touched again and infected me with insufferable greed.

Could it have been more perfect? Could I have known another soul so intimately as in that moment, with the two of us wound so tightly together? Entombed by rapture and the shame of knowing we’d breached the forbidden boundary and there was no going back.

“Jealousy is a callow schoolboy’s emotion that ends in hard feelings and bloody noses. What I feel for you, Miss Vespertine, would destroy lives.”

Over her shoulder, she shot me a smile–one so fucking beautiful, I wanted to frame it. Capture it. Study the alchemy of it. How wonderfully intoxicating one simple expression could be.

I couldn’t fucking do it, because all I could think about, all that mattered to me, was the girl. The beautiful girl with her autumn hair, and eyes that reminded me of both the sea and the sky. And she was everything. The earth, the sun, the moon. The air I breathed, and the tenacious beat that kept my eroded heart pumping.

It was in that moment, I believed him when he said he belonged to me. Like a vast ocean claimed by a single grain of sand.

Burrowed deep into the roots, it blossomed from the wounds of my broken heart, tearing through the stitches that burned with memories of those who’d tried to hurt me. Sometimes, the pain was too much to bear. But sometimes it felt good, because it meant that I was capable of feeling something.

Honestly, I should be ashamed of myself. I've been adding Keri Lake's books to my tbr for years and have listened to more than one enthusiastic friend fangirl over her, but did I pick up any of her work? No. Why? The world may never know why I do the things I do. I certainly don't. All I know is it was a big mistake. I could have been in Keri Lake heaven all these years, because let me tell you, I definitely was this week! My expectations couldn't have been higher after all the aforementioned waiting and high praise, but she blew those expectations right out of the fucking water! 



Nocticadia is a forbidden, gothic, age gap, dark academia, slowburn romance with horror/sci-fi vibes. It's set on the fictional island of Dracadia where our heroine, Lilia, is invited to attend a prestigious university on a full scholarship. Up until that invitation, Lilia is barely surviving, working long hours to pay rent and half of her sister's expensive boarding school tuition while managing a couple of community college classes on the side. Her dreams of earning a degree and providing a decent life for the only family she has left seems far out of reach, so when this seemingly too good to be true opportunity presents itself along with an additional way to afford her sister's schooling, she takes it despite her skepticism and any other concerns she may have. 



Devryn is an aloof, brilliant, and hot as hell professor at Dracadia University with a deadly reputation. He's studying a peculiar species of worms Lilia suspects are responsible for her mother's strange death, so she makes it her mission to become his lab assistant by any means necessary despite the rumors responsible for his nickname around campus, Doctor Death. Devryn and Lilia's chemistry in and out of the lab is intense, and before long, the sexual tension is just too much to bear. 



Devryn and Lilia's story gave me everything I could have hoped for! It's mysterious, atmospheric, intriguing, chilling, and macabre with a healthy dose of naughty student/teacher taboo. Both characters have interesting, tragic backstories that will break your heart, and if you're into sexy, morally gray antiheroes and smart, strong heroines, you'll absolutely adore these two. 



Nocticadia is a slow moving, beautifully written romance that is worth every bit of the journey. I usually devour books I'm loving as quickly as possible, but with this one, I actually prolonged my reading experience, because I wanted to live in this world for as long as I could. It's so well done and unique that I know it's going to be hard to find something that will give me similiar feels and that I'll enjoy as much as I did this one. 



Gothic romance fans, this one's for you!

P.S. I would love a book with Lilia's sister and a certain someone, especially after that ending!!

3.8 .✦ ݁˖

I am truly at a loss for words. I already expected it to be THIS GOOD. Please don’t judge me but the tropes in this book are absolute PERFECTION:

❤︎ Professor x college student trope (forbidden romance??🫣)
❤︎ Age gap 🥵
❤︎ Touch her & ☠️
❤︎ Slow burn and morally grey MMC

So guys, if you have any recommendations involving those tropes, PLEASE HELP YOUR GIRL OUT and comment those recs below 😂

Here’s what I think about the book 💭

˖°⋆🐚🫧 The Plot

I am gonna be honest. This would’ve been a solid 4 star read, if some of the parts of the book didn’t bore me. But I was in fact bored halfway through the book. The plot was slow but it was not dragging. It was the kind of slow plot that you appreciated to get to know more of the world of the book.

But I was bored because Lilia annoyed me at times and the plot was supee predictable. No surprises at all for me.

Furthermore, Dracadia Academy reminded me so much of Hogwarts but make it a college campus. The structure, the train, the way to reach campus by boat and the layout of the island are VERY similar to Hogwarts including a nearby town which is similar to Hogsmeade. I guess Ms. Lake got inspired by Harry Potter series.

.𖥔 ݁ ˖ The Characters

𓍢ִ໋🌷͙֒ Lilia

Look, I know she’s such a strong willed woman. She’s tenacious. She knew what she wanted and she would fight for it. BUT she pissed me off sometimes. This girl somehow kept bumping into people. It’s very comical and cliché honestly and this comes from a clumsy person but I don’t bump into people that often 🤡

Then, she had no backbone when it came to Devryck. Seriously. NO BACKBONE. When he confused her, she kept obliging what he wanted despite her own feelings. She knew she was angry and confused but she was still compliant to him. I wish she would put up more fight. Then, it’d be so much fun with all the bicker, arguments and fights!

´ཀ`❤︎ Devryck

AGHHH THIS MAN RIGHT HERE. ABSOLUTE PERFECTION. I honestly have nothing to complain about him. He’s ruthless BUUUUT he had reasons for everything he did. The way he yearned for Lilia was so hot and adorable.

One of the things that I love about him is that he knew Lilia was his student. So it’s off-limits for him. He knew how messed up it was to feel attraction toward her. He tried to control it all! He knew there’s power imbalance and he tried to make it fair with her. So that makes him not some creepy professor! AND he’s very dominant, possessive and obsessive over Lilia. Why do I love possessive MMC so much? 😭🙏🏻

˚.🎀༘⋆ The Romance

It’s a slow burn romance and it’s reaalllly slow but it’s so worth it. THIS IS WHAT A SLOW-BURN ROMANCE TRULY IS. It’s definitely the case “she falls first and he falls harder”.

I loved the fact that Lilia felt the attraction first toward Devryck ‘cause that’s actually acceptable in some sense. It’s normal for college students to have some harmless crushes on their professors. Meanwhile, Devryck didn’t feel the attraction toward her in the beginning. But I bet he got a bit curious over Lilia due to her circumstances. Then, his curiosity eventually led to his attraction toward her due to her personality and also diligence. This is what I called a well executed romance between college student x professor! It’s not some creepy ass professor who’s suddenly obsessed over a young beautiful and smart student and feels no moral dilemma. I’m so glad this isn’t that kind of romance!

Furthermore, the spice in this book was very HOOOOT. I giggled a lot while reading it. They’re both insane to pull all the stunts they did on Campus 😂 you should definitely read it to find out about those “stunts” 👀

⚠︎ Warning: .ᐟ.ᐟ DO NOT read this book in public because you won’t stop grinning or smiling while reading this 😝

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎⤿ ‎⋮ ⟢ started: march 14, finished: march 28

°˖⟡ ─ "I have lived a lifetime in death-a cold existence in an endless void. never feeling. never knowing the warmth of touch. every unfulfilling breath a suffocating reminder of how hollow I'd become. it wasn't until you came along and cast the first ray of light that I felt a pulse of life. a pull that I couldn't resist.”

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ 𓏲 ๋࣭ ࣪ ˖ summary ⟡〃📜
when Lilia Vespertine's mother succumbs to a mysterious illness that slowly made her unrecognizable both physically and emotionally, Lilia abandons all of her original life plans and decides to dedicate her time to one thing: figuring out what really happened to her mother. after receiving an offer to attend the prestigious Dracadia University's secretive medical program, she discovers this institution is the only place that studies the rare and fatal disease, Noctisoma—the very disease Lilia feels killed her mother. once Lilia arrives, she begins to learn all of the dark and dangerous secrets surrounding the school, the disease and her professor, Doctor Death.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ 𓏲 ๋࣭ ࣪ ˖ thoughts ⟡〃🪶
➳┆oh. my. GOD. this might just be my favourite book of 2026 so far... I am utterly obsessed and I fear I am going to fall into a rude slump in the near future because I am still stuck on the island of Dracadia with Lilia and Devryck. UGH. my heart still beats a little harder when I think about this story and it's been a few weeks since I finished it.

➳┆the setting of this book delivered in every single shape and form. this book included thriller, dark academia, dark romance AND gothic elements which made it remain extremely entertaining throughout. I felt genuinely creeped out several times while reading this and it really felt like I never knew exactly what was going on. while this book would be amazing at any time of the year, this is definitely the ultimate fall book and will surely give you the creeps while simultaneously making you fall head over heels for the characters.

➳┆I have to say, I was intimidated by this book at first because it's nearly 700 pages but I guarantee you, you will not even notice. I'm not sure how Keri Lake did it but the pacing of this book was nearly perfect. while the romance within this book was a beautiful slow-burn, the other events moved at a fast pace but still slowed down where necessary, ensuring that anticipation was constantly built. and the world-building? stellar. every time I picked this book up I was completely pulled away from reality and into this world.

➳┆and I also need to mention the fact that Keri Lake's way of writing was just perfection. the prose was complex and beautiful and you can just tell she really planned this book out. there was so much talk about parasites and just a bunch of medical terminology that I'm mostly unfamiliar with and usually would not go for in a book but she wrote this in such a way that you just need to know more. putting the book down was never an option, it was throughly addicting.

➳┆also, let's talk about how complex this story got at times and yet everything came full circle beautifully. there was not one plot hole in this book and that really just goes to show how much work and dedication went into this story—this book was planned out hard and that showed through its flawless beauty.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ 𓏲 ๋࣭ ࣪ ˖ characters ⟡〃🏹

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎˗ˏˋ ꒰ lilia vespertine ꒱ ˎˊ˗
"calling her beautiful was like calling the sun lukewarm. she'd blazed like the hottest part of a flame in that dress. and fuck me, I'd felt the heat."

➳┆I have only amazing things to say about this girl and she is easily an all-time favourite fmc of mine. for starters, this girl has a backbone and that was incredibly refreshing. despite her trauma and horrible events of her life, she is strong and bold and will never let people walk all over her or treat her poorly. her intelligence is also something I strongly admired. to think she was going to stay in her community college and she may not have gotten the opportunity to prove how capable and valuable she is is a crazy thought. Lilia is a real, relatable and thoroughly respectable character and she will be living in my head for a long time to come.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎˗ˏˋ ꒰ devryck bramwell ꒱ ˎˊ˗
"my dark sea. the mystifying depths that both captivated and terrified me."

➳┆your honour, I love him. this man was the most perfect mix of mysterious, profound, intense and sexy. sexy, sexy, sexy. he was so insanely intriguing, I was starving for his story and his chapters in his pov. I'll be so real, he was already a new favourite book boyfriend before he even opened his mouth. UH HUH, he's that good.

➳┆and yet, underneath this god of a man, there is a scared little boy who yearns for family and love and that just made me love him even more. I cried with him during his flashbacks and cried for his reality in the present day at times as well. I really did feel everything for this man.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎˗ˏˋ ꒰ lilia + devryck ꒱ ˎˊ˗
“and so the moth befriended the flame.”

➳┆the slow-burn, the yearning and the forbidden aspect created one unforgettable and enchanting love story between these two. Devryck had this urge to protect Lilia and stand up for her in quiet ways which turned into loud and unashamed ways. they were always each others, even before they cared to admit it. I loved the push and pull between these two. it wasn't prolonged enough to make you annoyed, it was prolonged just long enough that when they finally gave into one another, you're having a dance party in your room at 3am.

➳┆Lilia was so bold to Devryck's face and I devoured that. she had nothing to hide when it came to her feelings for him and she went for exactly what she wanted. the way she also cared for him was beautiful. she knew precisely what to do when he needed help and she would seriously do anything for that man.

➳┆I don't care much for smut in books these days but oh lord, if it's going to be written like it was in this then throw all the smut my way. I actually didn't want to skim these scenes for the first time in SO. LONG.

‎𓏲 ๋࣭ ࣪ ˖ quotes ⟡〃🪻

“jealousy is a callow schoolboy’s emotion that ends in hard feelings and bloody noses. what I feel for you, Miss Vespertine, would destroy lives.”

“he was moody, like rainy days and bitter coffee. sensual whispers in dark corners and the slow burn of fine whiskey.”

“that I would kill for you without a beat of hesitation, or remorse. and yet, at the same time, I could be reduced to nothing more than a pile of ash without you.”

"over her shoulder, she shot me a smile—one so fucking beautiful, i wanted to frame it. capture it. study the alchemy of it. how wonderfully intoxicating one simple expression could be."

“don’t hide from me, Lilia. you are no less beautiful than that day you walked into my classroom and stole my fucking breath.”

“the wealthy possess an insatiable appetite for the rare and priceless. they stare because you’re the only thing worth staring at.”

“you don’t have to be scared. I will never hurt you, Lilia. in fact, I’ll rain hell on anyone who ever hurts you again.”

"it was my mother, my refusal to accept her death, to accept what the world had taken from me, that had brought me to Dracadia in the first place. and it was there that I'd faced death head-on. so smitten, I fell in love with him-his abrasive heart and blood-stained hands. the dangerous and erudite professor, with fiery eyes and cold steel flesh. we hid away in shadows, stealing kisses under midnight stars. he taught me passion and courage, and to seize what I wanted by the teeth. and in return, I taught him how to feel again"

keri, come a little closer so that i can kiss you on yo fo’head because this right here??? was, is and will always be IT. this was just as darkly delicious as i remember, even the second time around and almost two years later. aged like fine wine. i am a fiend for this book — it is THAT good! this was one of my favourite reads of 2024 and it remains one of my top dark romances of all time. this is keri lake’s magnum opus. nothing has ever topped this!

if i could sum this book up with one word (but you know i won’t because i’m a yapper), it would be this: allure.

everything about this book, from the romance to the mystery plot to the dark gothic atmosphere, is so lush and immersive and compelling that it keeps drawing you in, page after page! it starts slow (but not boring) and oh so eerie, and unfolds into such a captivating story. the writing in this is so intricate and detailed, but it’s neither overwritten nor overly flowery. she struck an incredible balance with the storytelling and the prose style — chef’s kiss and nothing but tens for my good sis here 💋

when i say i want dark academia in my dark romance, this is what i mean!!! it’s not just about setting the story at a university and throwing in a few ornamental details about classes before giving up 🙄. the academic backdrop was developed so well, beyond just the aesthetic. the multi-faceted medical mystery and the way it tied into the lore of the island, the academy and the fields of study going on was so well executed. throw in the touch of horrorcore, the secret society, the curious case around caedmon and all the other devious happenings in the mix, and i was on my toes! the plot of this is anything but one-dimensional. there are so many threads and moving parts but instead of reading chaotically and unfocused, everything ties together masterfully. this book holds up even if you remove the romance — that’s how good the plot is.

but on that romance? oh, it was delectable. the pace was perfect. the slow burn was slow buuuuuuuuurning and the tension was so palpable, wheeew 😮‍💨. the agonizing over one another was eroding my stomach lining. lilia and devryck are so damn sexy together and their dynamic is so mind-meltingly (let me make up my words) addicting. nom nom nom. i will always defend a girl’s right to fuck her professor 🙂‍↕️ — ESPECIALLY one who’s as magnetic as theeeee doctor death.

professor bramwell…mmmmm. i do love me a mercurial and misanthropic asshole who’s only about his work and his woman 😂. make him intelligent, touch-averse and able to produce some of the most yearning achy lines ever? barking like a DAWG!!! this man breathed, and i was on my kneeeeeeeees. he was so possessive and protective and jealous and losing his mind after one taste — oh i do love them this pathetic and cuffed 🫦. he was also just…really funny 🤣. something about his sarcastic inner monologues fried me whenever he had no time for anybody lmao. also, he actually meant business and got things done. not like some of these twerps in many a dark romance. anyways, it goes without saying that this man was a MEAL. so…same lilia, same.

i also just really liked lilia as a heroine. smart, resourceful, and a sympathetic character. she was a great mix of vulnerable but not whiny and silly, which made her come across as down to earth and natural. my girl was asking questions! we love a curious fmc who seeks out answers and isn’t just sitting around clueless and waiting for things to happen. absolutely no fake bad-assery here too — i smile 😌. i was rooting for her every step of the way.

of course, reading it the second time around meant i knew everything that would ultimately come to pass, but i do remember when i read this the first time that some of the twists were unpredictable. the action packed into the last act of the book was riveting and had me spinning out. just…grabbed me by the nips and said here…get on the rollercoaster. i ate it uppppppppp.

i’d be remiss not to observe a moment of silence for that one scene in the dungeon-office-whatever-thingy…their first time iykyk. yeah. #needthat. RIP to my brain cells that i’ll never get back. ”panties are for the modest” 🙂‍↕️. i’m still gnawing on my kindle after that chapter. corner just chewed up and drool all over the place, for real 😩. to quote a wise and insightful netizen, “a gaga-thon was had”!

to wrap this up, this book is exactly what i like and consider to be dark romance excellence, containing the most desirable-to-me ingredients:

🖤 an mmc with a big dick, insane aura, is darkly funny and is morally nowhere on the goody-two-shoes map BUT IS NOT PROBLEMATIC on the basis that he’s rape-y. that is just unattractive to me under almost every circumstance…why would i want that? but devyrck was EVERYTHING I LIKE 😛

💜 an fmc who’s not…well…dumb. or erratic. just give me someone i actually want to back

🖤 a romance that’s more slowly paced than accelerated, with tons of chemistry and tension. it also isn’t just smut right from jump or all that there is in perpetuity. but when that smut hits?? it’s a heatwave and it’s earned 🔥

💜 a dynamic and engaging plot to pair well with the romance

🖤 proficient writing…because sadly, that’s not always a given and a lot of authors in DR need a thesaurus and/or to re-enroll in English 101 and a creative writing class. as in yesterday. but not ms keri here — she knows wassup 🙂‍↔️

that’s it. that’s literally the winning recipe for me. i am nothing if not a simple creature. i don’t ask for much, i don’t think 🤓

p.s. i’m still mourning not getting a proper book for the pairing teased in the wild ending to this 🥲. yes i read the little novella for those two back when i first read this book, but their story would have hit waaaaay more if we got a fully-fleshed out situation 😩. it’ll have to live on in my overactive imagination, i suppose. just another matter in the ever-growing pile for me and my fictional therapist to work through.

—————————————————————————————————

also, it only took me this long to read it the second time around because i was travelling and busy, but the first time had me devouring this almost 700-page tome in 24 hours — that’s how obsessed and hooked i was. kept me up until 5am one fine sunday morning and left me with the worst hangover (complimentary). i’ll never forget that 😆

keri, i’m begging at this point…do this AGAIN. por favor 😩

Devryck Bramwell aka Docort Death, yeah I would crawl through glass for that man.🧎🏻‍♀️he is the definition of a morally grey man who only cares for her and her only. “That I would kill for you without a beat of hesitation, or remorse. And yet, at the same time, I could be reduced to nothing more than a pile of ash without you.”
